intuition: Only the largest k values can affect the kth-largest value, so keep those in a min-heap.

brute_force.approach: Append each new value, sort all values in descending order, and read index k - 1.

optimal.approach: Maintain a min-heap of at most k values; its root is the kth-largest value seen so far.
optimal.time: O(log k) per add after initialization

edge_cases: The initial values may contain fewer than k elements.
Repeated values occupy separate heap positions.
